company.name: Careficient
company.tagline: Purpose Built for Care. Powered by Partnership.
company.positioning: Careficient is an EMR built exclusively for home health and hospice.

approvedStatements.text: Careficient is built exclusively for home health and hospice. Every workflow, regulatory update, clinical form, billing rule, integration, and implementation methodology is engineered specifically for those programs.
Careficient is a unified platform for every role. From intake to scheduling, clinical documentation, billing, quality review, and analytics, it removes silos, manual workarounds, and duplication.
Careficient takes a compliance-first approach: fully embedded regulatory updates, guardrails that prevent out-of-compliance actions, and audit-ready documentation trails.
Customers stay with Careficient because of responsive U.S.-based support, transparent communication, continuous enhancements, and a deep understanding of post-acute care.

Careficient holds CHAP EMR Verification, ACHC EMR Verification, and Age-Friendly Care at Home verification, has earned Inc. 5000 recognition in multiple years, and supports 1,100+ agencies across 2,700+ locations nationwide.
Careficient is built by nurses, for clinicians, and designed by clinicians and industry leaders so the system aligns with real-world demands.

categories.name: Cloud-Based & Reliable

careficient.text: Careficient is an all-in-one, cloud-based EMR that enables real-time documentation, remote access to patient records, and mobile-friendly documentation with offline capabilities.

categories.fallbackImpact: Gaps in platform and security put uptime, data protection, and field productivity at risk, and they get harder to fix as you add locations.

categories.name: Integrated Billing & Claims

careficient.text: Careficient's integrated claims management, built-in revenue cycle management tools, and payer rule enforcement with automated workflow validation reduce errors and billing delays.

categories.fallbackImpact: Billing gaps show up as denials, rework, and slower cash. Each manual step between documentation and payment is a place where revenue leaks.

categories.name: Eligibility Automation

careficient.text: Careficient connects intake, referral, and scheduling in one platform, with real-time eligibility verification built in.

categories.fallbackImpact: Intake and eligibility gaps let unverified coverage and missed deadlines through at the start of care, where they become denials later.

categories.name: Orders-Driven Workflows

careficient.text: Careficient structures care around orders-driven workflows with guardrails that prevent out-of-compliance actions and audit-ready documentation trails.

categories.fallbackImpact: When care plans, orders, and IDT/IDG work aren't connected, teams rely on manual checks to keep visits, orders, and documentation aligned.

categories.name: Interoperability & Integrations

careficient.text: Careficient's all-in-one platform eliminates the need for multiple disconnected systems, with integrated claims management and EVV built into the same platform.

categories.fallbackImpact: Interoperability gaps mean duplicate data entry across systems, which adds labor and increases the risk of errors and claim denials.

categories.name: Configurable Documentation

careficient.text: Careficient's intuitive, event-driven workflows reduce redundant tasks, with customizable clinical templates and real-time compliance prompts that help clinicians document accurately and quickly.

categories.fallbackImpact: Rigid documentation and configuration slow clinicians down at the point of care and force workarounds whenever your agency grows or changes.

categories.name: Real-Time Alerts & Validation

careficient.text: Careficient's compliance-first workflows include fully embedded regulatory updates, real-time compliance prompts, automated compliance checks, and built-in audit trails.

categories.fallbackImpact: Without real-time validation, compliance problems are found at audit or claim time instead of when they can still be fixed cheaply.

categories.name: Advanced Scheduling & EVV

careficient.text: Careficient combines dynamic scheduling with automated visit verification (EVV), and automated visit tracking simplifies payroll.

categories.fallbackImpact: Scheduling and EVV gaps lead to missed visits, frequency errors, and manual payroll and visit-verification work.

categories.name: Analytics & Reporting

careficient.text: Careficient provides real-time financial reporting, real-time financial insights, and customizable reporting.

categories.fallbackImpact: Without timely, role-based reporting, leaders find out about quality, compliance, and financial problems after the fact.

categories.name: Implementation & Support Quality

careficient.text: Careficient's implementation methodology is engineered specifically for home health and hospice, backed by responsive U.S.-based support, transparent communication, and continuous enhancements.

categories.fallbackImpact: Weak implementation and support stretch go-live, leave staff under-trained, and make every issue take longer to resolve.

sections.title: Platform & Security
sections.intro: The foundation: where your EMR runs, how it protects data, and whether clinicians can use it anywhere.

items.label: ONC compliant
items.impact: Without ONC certification, you may struggle to meet federal interoperability and information-blocking expectations.

careficient.text: ONC compliance is part of Careficient's platform requirements.

items.label: Mobile-optimized for real-time charting and decision support at the point of care
items.impact: Clinicians who can't chart in real time at the bedside finish notes later, which costs time and accuracy.

careficient.text: Careficient offers mobile-friendly documentation with offline capabilities, so field staff can chart in real time at the point of care.

items.label: Data protection: built-in redundancy, encryption, and multi-factor authentication
items.impact: Weak data protection exposes your agency to breach, downtime, and regulatory risk.

careficient.text: Careficient is built with redundancy, encryption, and multi-factor authentication for secure access.

items.label: SaaS / cloud-native
items.impact: Server-based systems add IT burden and make remote access and updates slower.

careficient.text: Careficient is an all-in-one, cloud-based EMR that enables real-time documentation and remote access to patient records.

items.label: Device-agnostic access
items.impact: Being tied to specific devices limits how and where staff can work.

careficient.text: As a cloud-based platform with mobile accessibility, Careficient gives staff remote access to patient records.

items.label: Offline documentation
items.impact: Without offline charting, clinicians in rural or low-signal areas can't document during the visit.

careficient.text: Careficient's mobile documentation includes offline capabilities so field staff can keep documenting without a connection.

items.label: Separate PROD / TEST / TRAIN environments
items.impact: Without separate environments, testing changes and training staff happen in live patient data.

careficient.text: Careficient supports separate production, test, and training environments.

items.label: Multi-factor authentication (MFA)
items.impact: Password-only access is one of the most common causes of account compromise.

careficient.text: Careficient includes multi-factor authentication for secure access.

items.label: Single sign-on (SSO) with Azure AD
items.impact: Without SSO, IT manages separate credentials and offboarding takes longer.

careficient.text: Careficient supports single sign-on with Azure AD.

items.label: SOC 2 or equivalent security framework
items.impact: Without an independent security framework, you rely on vendor assurances instead of verified controls.

careficient.text: Careficient operates under a recognized security framework.

items.label: Field-level permissions
items.impact: Coarse permissions expose more patient information to more people than necessary.

careficient.text: Careficient supports field-level permissions alongside role-based workflows.

items.label: Data retention controls
items.impact: Without retention controls, meeting record-retention requirements becomes a manual process.

careficient.text: Careficient includes data retention controls.

sections.title: Interoperability
sections.intro: How well your EMR exchanges data with referral sources, payers, pharmacies, and your back office.

items.label: HL7 / FHIR / CDA
items.impact: Without standards-based exchange, referral and clinical data has to be rekeyed.

careficient.text: Careficient supports standards-based data exchange through HL7, FHIR, and CDA.

items.label: API access
items.impact: Without API access, connecting other tools to your data depends on manual exports.

careficient.text: Careficient provides API access for integrations.

items.label: PBM integrations
items.impact: Without PBM integration, medication coverage and costs are managed outside the chart.

careficient.text: Careficient offers pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) integrations.

items.label: EVV aggregator integrations
items.impact: Without aggregator integration, state EVV submissions become a separate manual process.

careficient.text: Careficient's built-in EVV integrates with EVV aggregators.

items.label: Built-in clearinghouse (not bolt-on)
items.impact: A bolt-on clearinghouse adds a handoff between your EMR and payers, which means more rejections, more reconciliation, and slower cash.

careficient.text: Careficient's clearinghouse is built in, not bolted on, with integrated claims management and real-time claims tracking.

items.label: Built-in eFax
items.impact: Without built-in eFax, orders and referrals move through separate fax tools and get lost.

careficient.text: Careficient includes a built-in eFax function.

items.label: GL / accounting integrations
items.impact: Without GL integration, finance re-enters revenue data and closes the month slower.

careficient.text: Careficient integrates with general ledger and accounting systems.

sections.title: Intake, Referral & Eligibility
sections.intro: Everything that happens before the first visit, where clean data prevents denials later.

items.label: Referral timestamp (exact date and time)
items.impact: Without exact referral timestamps, you can't prove timeliness of care or measure intake speed.

careficient.text: Careficient records the exact date and time of every referral.

items.label: Multi-program support
items.impact: Separate intake for each program duplicates work and splits patient history.

careficient.text: Careficient is built exclusively for home health and hospice and supports both programs in one platform.

items.label: USPS / NCOA address validation
items.impact: Unvalidated addresses cause returned mail, routing errors, and claim problems.

careficient.text: Careficient validates addresses against USPS and NCOA data.

items.label: Electronic benefit eligibility with automatic re-verification
items.impact: Without automatic re-verification, coverage changes go unnoticed until a claim is denied.

careficient.text: Careficient provides real-time eligibility verification with automatic re-verification.

items.label: Referral source tracking
items.impact: Without referral source tracking, you can't see which relationships drive admissions.

careficient.text: Careficient tracks referral sources from intake onward.

items.label: NOE / NOA automation tied to payer rules
items.impact: Late or missed NOE/NOA filings can cost reimbursement for days of care.

careficient.text: Careficient automates NOE and NOA filing using payer rules.

items.label: Eligibility checking
items.impact: Manual eligibility checks slow intake and miss coverage problems.

careficient.text: Careficient includes real-time eligibility verification.

items.label: Referral entry
items.impact: Clunky referral entry slows intake and invites data errors that follow the patient.

careficient.text: Careficient's unified platform carries referral data from intake through scheduling and clinical documentation without duplicate entry.

items.label: Scheduling foundations set at intake
items.impact: If intake doesn't set up scheduling, the first visit depends on manual handoffs.

careficient.text: In Careficient, intake flows directly into scheduling on the same platform.
